summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a lithium carbonate sales and purchase contract between its joint venture SWA Lithium LLC and LG Energy Solution, Ltd., effective August 27, 2026, plus a material change report. The take-or-pay offtake covers 80,000 metric tons over ten years at 8,000 MT annually, priced off a monthly average index, delivered CIF Asia/Europe or DAP US. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation appears. This is an ordinary commercial supply contract, not a special situation; watch volume-weighted pricing trends.
